reviewConclusions.subject: registry-evidence
reviewConclusions.details: Every target parent and every exact optional platform package for @effect/tsgo, oxlint, oxfmt, and workerd exists at the reviewed version with an npm publication timestamp, SHA-512 integrity, and canonical tarball URL.

reviewConclusions.subject: effect@4.0.0-beta.107 patch
reviewConclusions.details: Retain only the public SchemaAST.Sentinel compatibility patch. The former private preResponse hunk is not required and must not be carried forward.

reviewConclusions.subject: @tanstack/router-core@1.171.21 patch
reviewConclusions.details: The prior TanStack router-core patch is obsolete at 1.171.21 and must not be regenerated or carried forward.

reviewConclusions.subject: @module-federation/* patch cohort
reviewConclusions.details: Module Federation patch applicability and semantic review are handled independently. The reviewed patch inputs are mature at this review boundary where their per-record maturity state says mature.

reviewConclusions.subject: react-server-dom-rspack@0.0.3 root test input
reviewConclusions.details: The newest upstream Rspack RSC package is mature but omits later official React Flight decoder security fixes. The root-only patch with SHA-256 11e471512012c0015883a233017b3ad695765e344cbd1d8174e79196ab6ba567 is retained solely for framework RSC regression tests while RSC remains disabled in the UltraModern company distribution. No companion package is published, and generated or migrated consumers receive neither this dependency nor a pnpm patch.

reviewConclusions.subject: minimum-release-age
reviewConclusions.details: Each registry record carries its own 1440-minute maturity state and exact maturity instant at reviewedAt. Only records marked immature require time-bounded release-age approval before that instant.
